Government Oversight Committee of the People's Majlis
Agenda

Meeting: 7th meeting
Meeting number: M20/M/SM/2026/07
Venue: Room 08
Date: 27 October 2026 (Tuesday)
Time: at 11:00

1. Reviewing the matter submitted requesting that arrangements be made to share concerns relating to the Minister of Homeland Security and Technology having said that the "Expat System", through which the Union for Employment Agencies of Maldives manages matters concerning foreigners, would be handed over to a Malaysian company and that services would begin through the new system in February 2025.

2. Reviewing the matter submitted by the Member for South Hulhumalé constituency, Dr. Ahmed Shamheed, at a committee meeting, stating that complaints are being received that the salaries and allowances of employees in some sectors have decreased since 1 November 2025, when the salaries and allowances of state employees changed in line with the standards of the "State Pay Framework", compiled under Law No. 11/2016 (State Remuneration Policy Act), following the amendments made to its standards on salaries and allowances.

3. Other matters.
